findings.text: Task switch scheduling installs the incoming task performance context on the current processor, preserving order that favors pinned over flexible and processor bound over task bound, and it notifies interested parties about context switches and processor callbacks when those facilities show activity.

Periodic tick handling advances a per processor throttle sequence, drains any pending throttle indication, clears the tick dependency marker, and refreshes frequency and unthrottle state for processor and current task contexts.

Wakeup service notifies consumers waiting on the ring buffer associated with an event lineage, redirecting child events toward their parent buffer, and delivers asynchronous input output notification when a pending termination indication is present, clearing that indication afterward.

Scheduling merge state carries a hardware admission flag that starts permissive and becomes restrictive after blocking, together with an event type discriminator used to exclude host events while guest execution is active on mediated virtualization capable monitoring units.
Cross processor read request carries a target event reference, a group mode selector distinguishing individual versus lineage reads, and a result holder populated by the read handler.

Scheduling attempt leaves ineligible events untouched, tries to place eligible groups onto hardware and tracks successful placements on an active roster, and on remaining inactive status it disables further hardware admission while diverging pinned failures toward error state with deferred wakeup signaling versus flexible failures toward rotation request with timer restart and user view refresh.

Execution transition enablement consumes a transient flag exactly when present, promotes events below inactive threshold to inactive, and when any promotion occurs it detaches the context from shared lineage and reschedules with accumulated type coverage.

Exit detachment always marks exiting, adds lineage flags for inherited events and group flag for revoked events, synchronizes child statistics into the parent under parental serialization, removes the event from its context, then releases child references with parental wakeup while retaining file governed parents with direct wakeup.

Context installation on task switch holds a read side critical section while acquiring the task context reference, then serializes with context locking while checking event presence, and orders processor and task disable and enable operations around pinned group handling to preserve priority.

Frequency and unthrottle adjustment serializes each context with its lock while walking associated monitoring unit contexts, skipping idle or interrupt less units, and brackets per roster adjustment with monitoring unit disable and enable.

Execution enable path masks interrupts across context locking and time freezing with clone release after restore, while execution removal path uses sleeping mutual exclusion for list traversal and interrupt saving spin serialization for lineage detachment, each releasing detached lineage afterward.

Owner detachment samples the owner under read side protection while holding a task reference when present, then takes nested owner serialization and rechecks before unlinking and publishing clearance with release ordering.

Exit path holds parental child serialization across attach state sampling and child synchronization, ring wakeup traverses buffer membership under read side protection, and group value emission masks interrupts across counter reads and copies while cross processor reads hold context locking during time updates.

User visible page refresh occurs solely when mapping references exist, updating timekeeping and shared view and reporting success, with group refresh cascading across siblings solely when leader refresh succeeds.

Scheduling eligibility excludes events at or below the off threshold, events failing filter match, and host events on virtualization mediated capable units during guest activity, as determined by type discriminator.

Sampling period derivation estimates the interval that would achieve configured frequency from observed counts over elapsed time scaled by a chosen time base constant, progressively shrinking larger magnitude operands based on bit length until intermediate products fit wide unsigned range, then dividing scaled values and handling vanishing divisor by returning scaled dividend.

Per roster frequency maintenance visits active filtered events, revives saturated interrupt counts before mode screening, and for frequency mode entries it stops for count snapshot, refreshes stamp, applies smoothed period adaptation solely on forward progress, and restarts with reload conditional on progress.

Adjustment work is skipped when neither frequency mode membership nor pending unthrottle indication exists at context or unit level, and inactive or interrupt less units are bypassed even when outer levels request work.

Value emission derives enabled and running totals from timer snapshots when total time reporting is requested, avoiding direct time updates that could deadlock in nonmaskable context, then follows individual versus group layout per format selection, augmenting with child time totals plus optional identity and loss fields.

Child synchronization optionally emits a read record when statistical inheritance is requested and task reference remains valid, then folds child count and enabled and running durations into parental accumulators with atomic addition.

Read processor selection retains the requested processor by default, favoring the current processor when advertised readability scope covers it via topology mask or when package locality matches under package readability capability, with out of range targets returned unchanged.

Scope to topology translation maps core level to sibling coverage, die level to die coverage, cluster level to cluster coverage, package level to core coverage, and system wide level to online coverage, yielding absence for other scope values.

Cross processor read returns promptly when a task bound context is no longer current on that processor, otherwise updates context and event timing plus sibling timing in group mode under lock, then performs direct counter read for individual mode or transactional reads across leader and siblings for group mode.

Pinned placement failure transitions toward error state and requests asynchronous error polling notification through pending flags plus deferred work queueing, requiring consumers to handle wakeup even when hardware admission is denied.

Execution removal walks the event roster with safe iteration against concurrent unlinking, detaches ownership for non kernel events before exiting each flagged entry, and defers lineage detachment until after list mutation completes.

Owner teardown races exit time clearance by revalidating ownership after acquiring owner serialization, ensuring list removal and publication happen solely when ownership persists beyond the initial sampling.

Lifecycle markers PERF_EVENT_STATE_OFF and PERF_EVENT_STATE_INACTIVE and PERF_EVENT_STATE_ACTIVE and PERF_EVENT_STATE_ERROR define ordering for eligibility screening and for promotion and failure handling.

Read format selectors PERF_FORMAT_TOTAL_TIMES and PERF_FORMAT_GROUP and PERF_FORMAT_TOTAL_TIME_ENABLED and PERF_FORMAT_TOTAL_TIME_RUNNING and PERF_FORMAT_ID and PERF_FORMAT_LOST control time derivation and emitted field composition for individual and group layouts.

Capability markers PERF_PMU_CAP_MEDIATED_VPMU and PERF_PMU_CAP_NO_INTERRUPT plus type marker EVENT_GUEST and detach markers DETACH_EXIT and DETACH_GROUP and DETACH_CHILD and DETACH_REVOKE plus control markers PERF_EF_UPDATE and PERF_EF_RELOAD plus transaction marker PERF_PMU_TXN_READ govern guest exclusion and interrupt handling and teardown and counter access.

Record marker PERF_RECORD_READ and notification markers POLL_ERR with SIGIO plus scope markers PERF_PMU_SCOPE_CORE and PERF_PMU_SCOPE_DIE and PERF_PMU_SCOPE_CLUSTER and PERF_PMU_SCOPE_PKG and PERF_PMU_SCOPE_SYS_WIDE plus readability markers PERF_EV_CAP_READ_SCOPE and PERF_EV_CAP_READ_ACTIVE_PKG identify emitted read records and async signaling and topology translation and locality optimization.
